report.explanation: Current read-only telemetry contradicts the alert: order checkout trace is OK, gateway logs show 200/ok, and all service metrics show low error rate (0.0012), p95 78ms, zero db pool waiters and zero dependency timeouts. No taxonomy cause is supported. The gateway deploy record (3.3.7, 499 min old, valid config) proves only version facts, not latency. Insufficient evidence to name a root cause; hand off for operator review.
missing_evidence: No telemetry shows degraded checkout: order trace OK (66ms), gateway error_rate 0.0012, p95 78ms, logs status 200.
No evidence of HTTP 500s, db pool exhaustion, redis timeouts, downstream latency, memory leak, or bad configuration.
No per-service latency/error breakdown isolating a failing checkout dependency.
No memory-retention time series to assess leak; deployment record alone cannot establish latency cause.
